MINE_ID.note: join key to Mines/MinesProdYearly; 7-digit id; not a feature itself (high cardinality), use joined mine attributes

CONTROLLER_ID.note: legal-entity id; could support a 'controller size' feature via aggregation but is an identifier

CONTRACTOR_ID.note: known at filing; use as binary is_contractor flag (blank = operator employee), not raw id

DOCUMENT_NO.note: form id; digits 2-8 encode filing Julian date -> filing lag is a possible derived feature, see quantification

ACCIDENT_DT.note: known; derive month, weekday; not raw date

CAL_YR.note: known; use as filter / optional numeric trend

EQUIP_MODEL_NO.note: free-text model; very high cardinality; recommend drop or presence flag

NO_INJURIES.note: number injured in accident; known at filing

NATURE_INJURY_CD.note: nature of injury (known from initial medical assessment at filing)

SCHEDULE_CHARGE.note: statutory days charged for permanent injury/death; deterministic function of outcome

DAYS_RESTRICT.note: outcome: restricted days, finalised at closing

DAYS_LOST.note: outcome: days away, finalised at closing

TRANS_TERM.note: permanently transferred/terminated: known only after outcome

IMMED_NOTIFY_CD.note: 15-minute immediate notification category is decided at accident time, before the 7000-1 form is filed; but code 01 Death is itself the fatality outcome -> strongly associated; keep only if collapsed to 'immediately reportable yes/no' or drop

INVEST_BEGIN_DT.note: MSHA investigation start date; investigations follow serious events, recorded after filing

NARRATIVE.note: free text written at filing; may mention outcome words; excluded from tabular model

CLOSED_DOC_NO.note: closing (return to duty) form number; exists only after case closes
